brief:
The Jerusalem Center for Research and Studies warned that the E1 settlement project east of occupied Jerusalem threatens the city, cautioning that delays in implementation do not signal abandonment of the plan, Shehab Wire reported. The center's warning comes as construction moves forward on 1,234 settlement units in the area.

E1, located between Jerusalem and the Dead Sea, has long been considered a flashpoint in Palestinian-Israeli disputes over settlement expansion and future borders.
